description: Says whether Mercury is retrograde on a date and which phase it is in (preShadow, retrograde, cazimi, postShadow or direct), with the sign, the cycle's five moments (pre-shadow, station retrograde, cazimi, station direct, post-shadow end) and days left to the next transition. Times are UTC, to the minute, from the ephemeris (JPL DE421, 2025–2030). This is astronomical timing, not a horoscope.

date.description: Date to check as YYYY-MM-DD (read as 12:00 UTC). Defaults to now.

name: is_mercury_retrograde
title: Is Mercury retrograde?
